chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: Ordered out of town in fifteen minutes
summary: A white man gives the band fifteen minutes to leave; Melvin has them push the bus down the road.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: So we went to the restroom to wash up and I told the men we could get service and so we ate, went back in the bus still waiting for this man to come back so the fellow could tow us down the road to this garage. Directly, a white guy came up, Little Dick was sitting behind the steering wheel, he hit on the door and Dick opened the door and he said, who's driving this tank? And you know he

talked so flat and everything, everybody looked around and Dick said, I'm driving it; better move this thing. Dick said we're waiting on the man, we're going to go to the garage. Who owns this tank? I said I own it. Well, you better move this bus. I said we got a little bus trouble, it can't run now; I said it can run, but I'm afraid we'll ruin the motor. I said I'm waiting on the mechanic, we're going to go down there about three miles. I'm telling you you got to move this thing. Now I work on the railroad with niggers sometime, but we just don't like niggers in our town. Now, our town ain't very big, see that telephone pole, that's where our line is. He pulled out a pocketwatch, and said, I'll give you fifteen minutes to be out of town; that's all you have to do, is get by that pole there. Everybody looked at each other. They guy walked off and we were just dumbfounded, what in the world. Melvin said, you all heard what the honkey said, we don't want to be in his town if he don't want us in

his town. He said, twelve men can move a house, let's push this bus out of this town. So a lot of the guys laughed and said, I thought you were a singer, I didn't know you were going to push a bus. He said I don't want this town, I don't like this town, and we got out of there and pushed that bus down there about a half a block.
